exposure: Group 1: received 16 mg Dexamethasone IV drip
Group II: received 16 mg Dexamethasone subcutaneous injection around the caesarean section scar after skin closure
Group III: received Placebo (500 cc saline infusion)
cohort: 120 pregnant women scheduled for elective Cesarean Section
finding: Local infiltration of dexamethasone was more effective than systemic administration in decreasing postoperative pain with a weaker antiemetic effect.
